input.instruction: Answer the customer’s policy question using the supplied records and handbook. Complete the requested fields and provide a concise explanation. This is an informational request; propose no account or claim actions.

messages.text: There was smoke from an accidental kitchen fire on October 1. My roommate Dev’s game console was damaged. It belongs entirely to Dev; I did not buy any part of it. Does my renters policy cover it because we share the apartment?
Is Dev listed as a named insured on an issued policy document?
No. We split the rent, but only I am listed on this policy. I am only asking about that console.

property_owner.description: Ownership category: named_insured for an owner listed in issued declarations, unnamed_roommate for a roommate owner not listed there, landlord for the building owner, or unknown when the relationship is unresolved.

property_scope.description: Scope conclusion for this particular item under the supplied ownership rule.

shared_rent_creates_insured_status.description: Whether sharing rent itself makes the roommate a named insured.
